summary: Frontend-only test of the internal mobile navigation fix in InternalLayout.jsx. Verified on mobile 390x844 (staff@visita.demo) and desktop 1440x900. Mobile hamburger (internal-mobile-menu) is visible, desktop aside is hidden, drawer (internal-mobile-nav) opens on tap and closes after link tap, Calendar navigates and renders content, and Patients/Rx regression links work with badges rendering. On desktop, aside is visible, hamburger hidden, Calendar click works. All acceptance criteria pass.

issues: Radix a11y warning: `DialogContent` requires a `DialogTitle` for internal-mobile-nav. Add a VisuallyHidden SheetTitle inside SheetContent to silence the console error and improve screen-reader support. Non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: Add a VisuallyHidden <SheetTitle>Navigation</SheetTitle> (and optional SheetDescription) inside SheetContent in InternalLayout.jsx to fix Radix Dialog a11y console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: InternalLayout renders the nav twice in DOM (aside + Sheet). data-testid values are duplicated. Tests must scope selectors (e.g. within [data-testid=internal-mobile-nav] or aside) or Playwright's .first will resolve to the hidden node. Consider making testids unique (e.g. sidebar-calendar vs mobile-sidebar-calendar) to avoid ambiguity.
Missing SheetTitle inside SheetContent triggers Radix a11y console errors on every open.
test_credentials: staff@visita.demo / Staff2026! via /signin identifier field (verified working).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile nav fix is confirmed working. When testing internal nav links via Playwright, scope selectors to either aside (desktop) or [data-testid=internal-mobile-nav] (mobile) because sidebar-<label> testids are duplicated between the hidden desktop aside and the Sheet drawer.
